title: Minimum Cost to Buy Apples II
summary: Each shop sells apples for its listed price. Roads are bidirectional and carry an empty-trip cost plus an apple-carrying multiplier. For every starting shop, minimize purchase price plus travel to a chosen shop empty and travel back carrying apples. The outbound and return paths may differ; buying locally requires no travel. Return one minimum per start.
officialConstraints: 1..1000 shops; prices 1..10^9; at most min(n(n-1)/2,2000) distinct non-self roads; road cost 1..10^9 and multiplier 1..100; zero-based valid shop IDs.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
